svg.title: PF7: decode KV per pod against the router's 0.8 threshold and the kv guard's 0.88
svg.desc: KV cache usage of each of the two decode pods and their mean, and the running and waiting requests per pod, while the load rises with the KV cache cut to 1 GiB per pod.
svg.text: PF7: decode KV per pod against the router's 0.8 threshold and the kv guard's 0.88
0.88 = 1.1 x 0.8: kv adds a pod above this mean
